title: Evidence report
summary: Answers one frozen research task with qualified conclusions, the supporting and contrary evidence behind each conclusion, and the limits of the search. Every factual conclusion is a declared assertion occurrence bound to the exact frozen body; report-level use is decided from authoritative observations and the independent auditor census, never from the producer's own claims.

requiredSections.purpose: Scope, audience and as-of of the answer; nonfactual framing carries an exclusion reason.
Conclusions with their qualifications, each a declared assertion occurrence.
Supporting and contrary evidence for each conclusion, cited by fragment.
Claim-level gaps, unmet obligations, search frontier and limits.

obligationTemplates.description: A task-specific conclusion stated with its qualifiers and supported by cited evidence.
Contrary or conflicting evidence considered for a conclusion, or the bounded search that found none.
A stated limit of the evidence or the search that bounds the conclusions.

extension: Every other report kind uses this same research-report-kind.v1 envelope: new pinned data (sections, constraints, obligation templates, assertion rules, qualifier profiles), contract fixtures and a qualification receipt. Adding a kind never adds an engine, a renderer branch or an agent workflow. Recommendations and forecasts expose premises and never receive a fact-entailed verdict; their use policy is OQ4.
